title: Apply a promo code at checkout
acceptance_criteria:
User Story: Apply a promo code to my cart

Acceptance Criteria:
- User can enter one promo code per order on the checkout page
- A valid code applies its discount and shows the new total
- Codes are not case sensitive
- Expired codes show the message "This code has expired"
- Codes with a minimum spend only apply when the cart subtotal meets the minimum
- The discount can never make the order total negative
- Removing the code restores the original total

expected_scenarios.description: Valid code applies discount and updates the total
Code entered in different letter case is accepted
Expired code shows 'This code has expired'
Subtotal exactly equal to the minimum spend allows the code (boundary)
Subtotal just below the minimum spend rejects the code
Discount larger than the cart value results in a total of 0, not negative
Applying a second code to the same order is not allowed
Removing the code restores the original total
Invalid / nonexistent code is rejected with an error
Cart change after applying a code (dropping below minimum) re-evaluates the discount
